title: 拿走几个还剩几个
subtitle: 减法就是把一堆分成两堆
character: wearing a red t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, bold flat graphic art with thick black outlines and flat fills in brick red, deep teal and cream, simple chunky shapes, slight printed grain, the illustration covers the entire image area

pages.zh:
盘子里有八个小饼干。
我吃了三个。
妈妈问还剩几个，
我又把剩下的
一个一个重新数了一遍。
pages.scene: The little boy stands at a table beside a plate with a few biscuits on it, counting them with one finger.

pages.zh:
其实不用重新数。
八个里拿走三个，
剩下五个。
这件事叫「减法」，
写成 8 − 3 = 5。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: eight circles in a row on a cream background with the first three crossed out and the remaining five left plain. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
减法就是把一堆分成两堆：
一堆拿走了，
一堆留下了。
两堆合起来，
还是原来那么多。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one group of eight circles on a cream background split by a line into a group of three on the left and a group of five on the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以减法和加法
是一对。
八减三等于五，
那么五加三
就一定等于八。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows on a cream background: the top row shows eight circles with three moved away, the bottom row shows five circles with three moved back. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不用一个一个数，
可以往回退。
从八开始，
退一步是七，退两步是六，
退三步是五。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one number line on a cream background marked from zero to ten, with three short backward arrows going from 8 to 5. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
减法还能问：
差多少？
我有八个，你有五个，
把两排对齐，
多出来的三个就是差。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows of circles on a cream background lined up one above the other: eight on top, five below, and the three extra ones on the top row marked. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
减去零，
一个也没拿走，
还是原来那么多。
减去它自己，
就一个也不剩了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rows on a cream background: the top row five circles all left plain, the bottom row five circles all crossed out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
大数减小数好办，
小数减大数就不够了。
我只有三块饼干，
拿不走五块。
不够的时候要先借。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three circles on a cream background with five crossing marks above them, two of the marks having no circle underneath. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
十几减几，
可以先拆成十和几。
十三减五：
先用十减五得五，
再加上那三个，是八。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: on a cream background, one bundle of ten sticks and three loose sticks, with five sticks being taken from the bundle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
生活里到处是减法。
买东西找钱，
是减法；
算还有几天放假，
也是减法。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two small pictures side by side on a cream background: a coin with a smaller coin beside it, and a calendar with a few days crossed out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
检查对不对，
只要加回去。
剩下的加上拿走的，
如果等于原来那么多，
就没算错。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small sum on a cream background: five circles plus three circles joined by an arrow into a group of eight. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我不数了。
八个吃了三个，
剩五个。
我把五块饼干
分了两块给妹妹——那就剩三块。
pages.scene: The little boy holds out two biscuits to a smaller child at the table, three biscuits still on his own plate.
